name: temzdf-runtime
description: temzdf's shipped scripts (defaults, Vim mode), bundled by crates/temzdf-script/build.rs with esbuild. npm packages used here must be widely used, maintained, and plain ES code (no Node APIs: they run in QuickJS). The devDependencies are tools (scripts/ts-types.ts) and types (type-fest; @types/node for the Node scripts under scripts/), never bundled.
